test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 27 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Out of the four number-pairs listed, three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the odd one.
solution:
The logic followed here is:

The difference between the two numbers is a prime number except one.

23 - 4 = 19 (a prime number)

85 - 18 = 67 (a prime number)

**30 -15 = 15 (not a prime number)**

35 - 6 = 29 (a prime number)

Hence, (15, 30) is is different.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 
• The numbers in pairs (4, 23), (18, 85), (6, 35) are not divisible with each other whereas in (15, 30) the numbers are divisible.

Hence, (15, 30) is different.
